observed_reference.observation: The intentionally incomplete one-net series fragment evaluates successfully. Circuit Engine reports five explicit warnings. With the pinned PhiCad kicad-cli, independent KiCad DRC reports zero errors and four environment/presentation warnings. Missing kicad-cli remains a non-pass skip.

known_findings.meaning: The small fragment has no schematic-sheet element.
known_findings.action: Add a reviewed sheet in a later electrically complete example.

known_findings.meaning: Two pins are intentionally free because this is a one-net workflow fragment, not a powered LED circuit.
known_findings.action: Do not use this fixture as an electrical design or fabrication input.

known_findings.meaning: The generic footprint geometry differs from the selected supplier footprint, once per component.
known_findings.action: Resolve and independently review exact package identity before manufacturing.

known_findings.meaning: The current KiCad environment does not register the generated tscircuit footprint library.
known_findings.action: Register or embed the generated library mapping before advanced editing.

known_findings.meaning: Generated reference text is below the current KiCad board-rule minimum.
known_findings.action: Apply qualified presentation rules before a manufacturing release.

known_findings.meaning: PhiCad Verify is unavailable when the independent kicad-cli is absent; the combined verdict is not a pass.
known_findings.action: Provide the exact pinned PHICAD_KICAD_CLI or PHICAD_BUILD.

claims_not_made: This example is not fabrication-ready; it is intentionally electrically incomplete.
Native PhiCad materialization is unavailable in V1; exact Circuit JSON verification does not create an applied native revision.
Zero KiCad DRC errors is not evidence of electrical completeness or manufacturing correctness.
